description: use_projection(server_pid | nil, fn, opts) -> projected_value. When server is nil, return Keyword.get(opts, :disconnected, :disconnected). On first render for this slot: call add_projection on the server (async cast), apply fn to raw initial state from use_observable slot for initial value. On re-render: read from hook slot (value written by batched update handler). On unmount: remove_projection cast to server; last projection removed triggers unsubscribe. Hook slot stores {server_pid, last_projected}.
title: Implement use_projection/3
